## About the model



iLand is a model of forest ecosystem dynamics, simulating the processes [growth], [mortality] and [regeneration] on watershed to landscape scale. Individual tree [competition for resources](resource-availability-and-competition.qmd) and [environmental influences](constraints-to-resource-utilization.qmd) on forest processes are explicitly modeled by iLand. The model is designed to investigate effects of [climatic changes](constraints-to-resource-utilization.qmd) on forest ecosystem dynamics with particular focus on [natural disturbances](mortality.qmd). It aims at harnessing these capacities for questions of [sustainable forest management](management.qmd) under [changing environmental conditions](constraints-to-resource-utilization.qmd).

## About the implementation


The iLand modeling software is a software tool to simulating individual trees at landscape level. It is based on [open source] technologies and written in C++ using the [Qt](qt.qmd) toolkit. Special [development goals](technical-design.qmd) are performance, a rich GUI and extended scripting facilities.

### [iland-book](https://iland-model.org/iland-book)


The "book" is a useful resource for both beginners and advanced users of iLand. It provides guidelines for getting to know the model, and covers advanced topics such as parameterization of new species. It complements this Wiki in providing a compact and accessible way to working with iLand.



### iLand discord


The community of iLand users is growing over the years and it was alway a pleasure to interact with. To facilitate further communication between iLanders we provide a Discord channel.
